protocol.boundary: Pretokenized prompts: padding, H2D, backbone, readout, CPU logits materialization. GPU synchronized. HTTP validation recorded separately.
protocol.cells: 16 independent prompts plus the same 16 prompts in a mixed-length batch
protocol.arm_order: Rotated native, Python FP16, Python BF16 across fresh processes
protocol.memory: Process RSS/PSS and per-process NVML sampled every 20ms; startup and inference peaks separate. Max across lifecycles.
protocol.isolation: No concurrent compilation or GPU work during measurements
protocol.latency_summary: Median of process medians; ranges are min/max process medians
protocol.precision: Native F16 projections, F32 residuals/normalization/recurrent state and accumulation; BF16 embeddings. FP32 reference captured without FLA/causal-conv1d.

validation.prompt_contract_tests: 18 passed: 48 prompt/token pairs plus two truncation fixtures
validation.racecheck: glide_* and lighton_gated_norm: zero errors or warnings
validation.strict_fp32: 0.4B final build and 0.8B/2B pre-buffer-reuse strict paths: max option-logit error <= 0.00002
validation.http: Each model: 8 fixture requests and 3 reordered/repeated batches; two calls per cell; no decision mismatches
limitations: L4 only; A100 and Metal execution not tested in this CUDA work
Performance qualification covers the pinned text checkpoints and this fixture, not vision/loop/NVFP4 variants
BF16 Python decision drift is reported, not suppressed

validation.http: 11 cases per model, including reordered/repeated batches; two calls per case
validation.independent_oracles: DeltaNet through 5129 tokens / 16 heads; dense attention padding and offsets through 8193 keys

limitations: L4 measurements only; other GPUs were not benchmarked.
